faqs.question: How do I create a time block?
faqs.answer: Simply input your tasks and the time you want to allocate for each, and the scheduler will organize them.

faqs.question: Can I adjust my time blocks?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can easily adjust your time blocks as needed.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for team scheduling?
faqs.answer: While primarily designed for individual use, it can also be adapted for team planning.
